source:
@@U00489@@
What a waste! I feel it now! I've heaped on myself all the treasures of the human mind, and for what? When finally I sit down, there’s nothing new wells up from within me, no new force, no new strength. I’m not a hairsbreadth taller, no single step closer to the Infinite.
translation:
@@U00489@@
多么浪费啊！我现在感觉到了！我把人类心灵的所有宝藏都堆在自己身上，为了什么？当我最终坐下来时，我内心没有任何新的涌出，没有新的力量，没有新的力量。我并没有高出毫厘，也没有离无限更近一步。
